decisions_made: Resource-first investigation completed before implementation, per Parker. Nine recent panes is proposed preparation priority, not nine retained live browser pages.

Keep shared 256 MiB disk cache; recommend closing page contexts after capture and releasing hidden native buffers, preserving notes and position. No duplicate pinned PNG cache without measured benefit.

Actual nine-page default browser PSS 1975 MiB; Vulkan 1245 MiB PSS plus859 MiB NVIDIA; closed contexts leave293/475 MiB browser PSS. Pixel arithmetic adds281 MiB decoded payload and48 MiB PNG for sampled nine native views; native driver allocation unmeasured.
Disk census:58 render versions229 MiB plus6 media21 MiB. Resource browser warm/default161 MiB; one captured page498 MiB. These are retained snapshots, not transient peaks.
Prior cache-read benchmark immediately followed writes;1–6 ms is hot filesystem cache, not a cold disk measurement.
